preferredRoute: Two fixed fictional adult characters created and rendered locally using individually verified permissive 3D components; no per-customer body generation

options.publisherFinding: Core mesh/targets/skins use CC0, separate from GPL/AGPL program source. The asset-pack directory distinguishes CC0 and CC-BY packs. Female Skins 01 and male Skins 02 are listed in the CC0 section.
options.possibleUse: Locally author exactly one fixed female and one fixed male fictional character, with shared camera, lighting and pose conventions; render lossless full-resolution masters once.
requiredEvidence: pinned exact release and asset checksums
license text and per-component provenance for mesh, skin, eyes, hair, clothing, pose and lights
record artistic modifications and fixed character presets
human visual/anatomy/pose review and product sign-off
options.limitations: No selected files, renders, character presets, production look or final asset rights approval yet. Free software is not zero local compute or artist time. High resolution alone does not establish photorealism.

options.publisherFinding: Official demo-file listing labels Human Base Meshes v1.4.1 (49 MB, Blender 4.2 LTS or newer) CC0. Blender permits commercial use of created artwork; rights to imported components remain separate.
options.possibleUse: Alternative locally authored character starting point using a known camera/render rig.
options.limitations: Base meshes are not finished photorealistic figure photographs or a verified matching adult male/female asset pair. Individual downloaded package, materials and final renders still require file-level review. No package downloaded.

options.publisherFinding: Provider licenses allow broad photo use and editing but impose restrictions; recognizable people, endorsement, face replacement, redistribution/caching and exports need exact-use review. A generic free-photo label does not supply all those permissions.
options.limitations: No exact pair identified with matched pose, lighting, high resolution, neutral base clothing and documented person permissions for optional face replacement. Do not substitute arbitrary stock photos.

options.publisherFinding: Repository contains only 160x297 WebP previews. Expected JPEG master filenames/hashes are known but master bytes and original creation terms are absent.
options.limitations: Do not treat stage-script identity hashes, apparent AI style, or filenames as commercial rights, native-resolution provenance or permission to replace faces.
